metadata.title: JSE SENS Financial Concept Dictionary & Alias Inventory

accounting_revenue.name: Accounting Revenue
accounting_revenue.description: Statutory IFRS revenue from contracts with customers reported on the income statement.
approved_aliases: revenue from continuing operations decreased by
revenue from continuing operations increased by

sale_of_merchandise.name: Sale of Merchandise
sale_of_merchandise.description: Revenue derived specifically from the sale of merchandise/goods, excluding finance charges and service fees.
approved_aliases: sale of merchandise from continuing operations

retail_sales.name: Retail Sales
retail_sales.description: Customer-facing retail sales metric, often including concessions and franchise sales.

turnover.name: Turnover
turnover.description: Top-line turnover disclosed in financial announcements, which may include excise duties or concession turnover.

cost_of_sales.name: Cost of Sales
cost_of_sales.description: Direct expenses incurred in the production or acquisition of goods sold.

gross_margin.name: Gross Margin
gross_margin.description: Gross profit divided by revenue or sale of merchandise, expressed as a percentage.

trading_profit.name: Trading Profit
trading_profit.description: Operating profit before non-trading items, interest, and taxation (retailer-specific trading earnings).

trading_margin.name: Trading Margin
trading_margin.description: Trading profit divided by merchandise sales or revenue, expressed as a percentage.

operating_profit.name: Operating Profit
operating_profit.description: Statutory operating profit from ordinary activities before net financing costs and tax.

operating_margin.name: Operating Margin
operating_margin.description: Operating profit divided by revenue, expressed as a percentage.

profit_before_finance_costs_and_tax.name: Profit Before Finance Costs and Tax
profit_before_finance_costs_and_tax.description: Operating result before finance income, finance costs, and taxation (PBIT).
approved_aliases: Profit before finance costs and tax
Operating profit before finance costs and tax

ebit.name: Earnings Before Interest and Tax (EBIT)
ebit.description: Standardised economic earnings before net finance expense and corporate tax.

ebitda.name: EBITDA
ebitda.description: Earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation, and amortisation.

adjusted_ebitda.name: Adjusted EBITDA
adjusted_ebitda.description: EBITDA adjusted for non-trading, restructuring, or one-off exceptional items.

normalised_ebitda.name: Normalised EBITDA
normalised_ebitda.description: EBITDA adjusted to reflect ongoing underlying operational run-rate.

depreciation_and_amortisation.name: Depreciation and Amortisation
depreciation_and_amortisation.description: Total depreciation of tangible PPE and amortisation of intangible assets.

depreciation_amortisation_expense.name: Depreciation and Amortisation Expense (IS)
depreciation_amortisation_expense.description: Depreciation and amortisation expense recognised on the income statement.

depreciation_amortisation_cashflow_addba.name: Depreciation and Amortisation Cash Flow Addback
depreciation_amortisation_cashflow_addba.description: Non-cash D&A addback in the cash generated from operations reconciliation note.
approved_aliases: Depreciation and amortisation cash flow addback

cash_generated_from_operations.name: Cash Generated From Operations
cash_generated_from_operations.description: Gross cash generated by operating activities before tax and finance cash flows.
approved_aliases: cash generated from operations increased by
cash generated from operations amounted to

operating_cash_flow.name: Operating Cash Flow
operating_cash_flow.description: Net cash flow from operating activities after net working capital, tax paid, and finance costs.

working_capital_movement.name: Working Capital Movement
working_capital_movement.description: Net balance-sheet change in working capital assets and liabilities.

working_capital_cash_flow.name: Working Capital Cash Flow
working_capital_cash_flow.description: Cash-flow statement working capital adjustment where positive values denote a cash inflow.
approved_aliases: Working capital cash flow (positive = cash inflow)

cash_capex.name: Cash Capital Expenditure
cash_capex.description: Total cash paid for capital expenditure on property, plant, equipment, and intangibles (cash-flow statement basis).

total_capex.name: Total Capex (Additions Basis)
total_capex.description: Sum of all capital additions across expansion, maintenance, and software.

capex_expansion.name: Expansion Capex
capex_expansion.description: Capital expenditure directed towards expanding operations / growth capacity.
approved_aliases: Acquisition of plant and equipment to expand operations

capex_maintenance.name: Maintenance Capex
capex_maintenance.description: Capital expenditure directed towards sustaining existing operational capacity.
approved_aliases: Acquisition of plant and equipment to maintain operations

intangible_additions.name: Intangible Additions
intangible_additions.description: Cash expenditure or additions for computer software and intangible assets.

cash_and_cash_equivalents.name: Cash and Cash Equivalents
cash_and_cash_equivalents.description: Cash on hand, bank balances, and short-term liquid deposits on balance sheet.

money_market_funds.name: Money Market Funds
money_market_funds.description: Assets held at fair value through profit or loss in money market investment vehicles.
approved_aliases: Current assets held at fair value (money market)

interest_bearing_borrowings.name: Interest-Bearing Borrowings
interest_bearing_borrowings.description: Formal financial debt and bank borrowings on balance sheet face. Evidenced as EX_LEASES via balance-sheet presentation separate from lease liabilities (IAS 1.54 / IFRS 16.47).

default_qualifiers.custom_notes: Evidenced as EX_LEASES via balance-sheet presentation separate from lease liabilities under IAS 1.54 / IFRS 16.47.

bank_overdraft.name: Bank Overdraft
bank_overdraft.description: Overdraft facilities utilised at the reporting date.

reported_net_cash.name: Reported Net Cash
reported_net_cash.description: Management-reported net cash balance (cash and equivalents less borrowings). Evidenced as EX_LEASES via explicit note wording or reconciled footnote formula.

default_qualifiers.custom_notes: Evidenced as EX_LEASES via explicit label wording or reconciled footnote formula (e.g. TRU Note 49 formula).

reported_net_debt.name: Reported Net Debt
reported_net_debt.description: Management-reported net debt balance (borrowings less cash balances). Evidenced as EX_LEASES via explicit note wording or reconciled footnote formula.

default_qualifiers.custom_notes: Evidenced as EX_LEASES via explicit label wording or reconciled footnote formula.

lease_liabilities.name: Total Lease Liabilities
lease_liabilities.description: Total IFRS 16 lease liability commitments (current plus non-current).

lease_liabilities_current.name: Current Lease Liabilities
lease_liabilities_current.description: Portion of lease liabilities due within 12 months.

lease_liabilities_noncurrent.name: Non-Current Lease Liabilities
lease_liabilities_noncurrent.description: Portion of lease liabilities due after 12 months.

issued_shares_current.name: Issued Shares Current
issued_shares_current.description: Total ordinary shares issued by the company (including treasury shares).

treasury_shares.name: Treasury Shares
treasury_shares.description: Ordinary shares held by subsidiaries or share incentive schemes.
approved_aliases: Note 14: Treasury shares at reporting date

external_shares_ex_treasury.name: External Shares Excluding Treasury
external_shares_ex_treasury.description: Total issued shares less treasury shares held.

period_end_external_shares.name: Period-End External Shares
period_end_external_shares.description: External share count as of the economic period-end date.

announcement_date_external_shares.name: Announcement-Date External Shares
announcement_date_external_shares.description: External share count as disclosed on the results announcement publication date.

weighted_average_basic_shares.name: Weighted Average Basic Shares
weighted_average_basic_shares.description: Time-weighted average ordinary shares for basic EPS calculation.
approved_aliases: Weighted average number of shares for the reporting period (millions)

weighted_average_diluted_shares.name: Weighted Average Diluted Shares
weighted_average_diluted_shares.description: Time-weighted average shares adjusted for dilutive share options and rights.
approved_aliases: Diluted weighted average number of shares for the reporting period (millions)
ambiguous_aliases: diluted weighted average number of shares

eps.name: Basic Earnings Per Share (EPS)
eps.description: Basic earnings per share in ZAR cents.
approved_aliases: earnings per share from continuing operations
earnings per share for the year

diluted_eps.name: Diluted Earnings Per Share
diluted_eps.description: Diluted basic earnings per share in ZAR cents.

heps.name: Headline Earnings Per Share (HEPS)
heps.description: Headline earnings per share according to SAICA Circular 1/2023 in ZAR cents.
approved_aliases: headline earnings per share from continuing operations
headline earnings per share for the year
headline earnings per share increased by
headline earnings per share decreased by

diluted_heps.name: Diluted Headline Earnings Per Share
diluted_heps.description: Diluted headline earnings per share in ZAR cents.

tax_expense.name: Tax Expense
tax_expense.description: Total income tax expense recognised in the statement of comprehensive income.

effective_tax_rate.name: Effective Tax Rate
effective_tax_rate.description: Effective group taxation rate as a percentage of profit before tax.

statutory_tax_rate.name: Statutory Tax Rate
statutory_tax_rate.description: Standard South African statutory corporate income tax rate.

dividend_per_share.name: Dividend Per Share
dividend_per_share.description: Declared dividend per ordinary share in ZAR cents.
approved_aliases: gross cash dividend amount per share

annual_dividend_per_share.name: Annual Dividend Per Share
annual_dividend_per_share.description: Full-year aggregate dividend per ordinary share in ZAR cents.

final_dividend_per_share.name: Final Dividend Per Share
final_dividend_per_share.description: Final dividend declared at the end of the financial year in ZAR cents.

interim_dividend_per_share.name: Interim Dividend Per Share
interim_dividend_per_share.description: Interim dividend declared at the half-year reporting date in ZAR cents.

nav_per_share.name: Net Asset Value Per Share
nav_per_share.description: Net asset value divided by external shares, in ZAR cents.
approved_aliases: net asset value per share increased by

tangible_nav_per_share.name: Tangible Net Asset Value Per Share
tangible_nav_per_share.description: Net asset value excluding goodwill and intangibles, in ZAR cents.
approved_aliases: Tangible net asset value per share

attributable_earnings.name: Attributable Earnings
attributable_earnings.description: Profit for the period attributable to equity holders of the parent.

headline_earnings.name: Headline Earnings
headline_earnings.description: Aggregate headline earnings in ZAR (before dividing by share count).

profit_for_period.name: Profit for the Period
profit_for_period.description: Consolidated profit after taxation for the reporting period.
